items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: They call me Pajo, Ponge, Pango, and everything but Pajo.

ctx.x: That's right. So then they called me Lizzie Miles. Well, it was an easy name to say. Pajot would have been too hard to say. They'd have been calling me Pago and Pajo, which they do right now. That's how they pronounce the name. Very few people pronounce it Pajo. They call me Pajo, Ponge, Pango, and everything but Pajo.
Well, the Miles name, was it just made up or was there, in other words, just because you were smiling, they made up the Miles?
